channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Vero Beach parents sue city over infant son's remains allegedly disturbed, reburied without consent
item.description: Two Vero Beach parents filed an amended lawsuit alleging their infant son's remains were accidentally disturbed during maintenance at Crestlawn Cemetery and reinterred without their knowledge or consent.

item.title: Indian River County Sheriff releases details after 2 bodies found near Sebastian
item.description: Sheriff Eric Flowers said Thursday there is no connection between two men whose bodies were found in the same area this week near U.S. Highway 1 and the north county line.

item.title: Jensen Beach gym holds fundraiser workout for family of 5-year-old killed in bike accident
item.description: Orangetheory Fitness in Jensen Beach is raising funds for the family of Garrett Leonard, a 5-year-old who was killed in a bicycle accident at a motocross park in Miami.

item.description: A proposed 85-acre development off Indrio Road and Russakis Road in St. Lucie County is moving closer to reality, but neighbors are pushing back against the project they say will eliminate the area's rural character. item.title: Three lawsuits challenge Florida property tax amendment before November vote
item.description: Three separate legal challenges now target Amendment Three, a constitutional amendment placed on the November ballot by state lawmakers that would expand homestead property tax exemptions.

item.description:
Park Vista Community High School's football team is building on late-season momentum as the Cobras set their sights on the state playoffs in 2026. The Cobras struggled to find their footing early in 2025, but finished strong, winning four of their last five games.

item.title: Women's Professional Baseball League unveils team names and logos ahead of August season debut
item.description: Four teams with names inspired by pioneering women will begin play on August 1 in Springfield, Illinois, marking the return of women's professional baseball.

item.title: Lionel Messi leads Argentina to dramatic 3-2 World Cup comeback victory over Egypt
item.description: Argentina scored three goals in the final 11 minutes to overcome a 2-0 deficit and advance to the World Cup quarterfinals, with Messi scoring his eighth goal of the tournament.

item.title: US men's World Cup match against Belgium sets all-time viewership record with 30 million viewers
item.description: Monday's World Cup match became the most-watched soccer telecast in U.S. history, with viewership peaking at 36 million during the second half of the 4-1 loss.

item.title: IOC ends neutral status vetting for Russian athletes ahead of 2028 Los Angeles Olympics
item.description: The International Olympic Committee advised Olympic sports bodies to end the three-year program that vetted Russians for neutral status at qualifying events.

item.title: Updated Live Local Act takes effect in Florida, expanding affordable housing opportunities
item.description: Florida's revised Live Local Act became active, expanding affordable housing opportunities across the state while fueling debate at the local level.

item.title: St. Lucie County neighbors oppose 85-acre Indrio Town Center development near I-95
item.description: County planning and zoning unanimously recommended rezoning 85 acres off Indrio Road and Russakis Road from agricultural to planned retail workplace. County commissioners are expected to vote on the rezoning in August.

item.description: The St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office identified Dale Mincey, 41, as the suspect in a shooting that killed Andre Leonard Barnes, 66, of Fort Pierce on Tuesday.
